CustomField.description: The NUCC specialty (Verifiable's NUCC taxonomy) this Provider specialty links to; set by personnel ingestion (Primary / Secondary Provider Specialty). Linked by record Id because the taxonomy code is not guaranteed unique. Cleared if the taxonomy record is deleted: Taxonomy_Code__c keeps the code, and ingestion refills this field from it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The specialty in the NUCC taxonomy. Taxonomy Code holds its code.
CustomField.label: NUCC Taxonomy
